properties.name: text
properties.comment: The plain text (Text): the source's blocks with the markup removed, joined by line feeds (markdown_plain_text); a view onto the parsed document. A write replaces the document with markdown that reads back as that text (punctuation escaped, each line feed a hard line break; leading white space on a line and trailing line feeds are not kept), clears the history and raises content_changed, text_changed when the plain text changes, then selection_changed. Throws std::invalid_argument for invalid UTF-8 and std::length_error past maximum_bytes.

table.description: The plain text of the document.

hand: a view onto plain_text_; write_view escapes the text into markdown and adopts it

properties.name: read_only
properties.comment: Whether the user may select and copy but not change the document (ReadOnly); a view onto the editing engine.
hand: a view onto the editing engine

properties.name: word_wrap
properties.comment: Lines wrap at the box's width (WordWrap, the default); without wrapping a line is one row and the box scrolls horizontally.
hand: written drops the wrap width and the sideways scroll

properties.name: accepts_tab
properties.comment: Whether Tab inserts a tab (AcceptsTab); off (the default), Tab moves the focus.

properties.name: control_bar_visible
properties.comment: Whether the control bar is shown (the default). Its keys work without it. A change closes the heading menu.
hand: written clears the bar's hot and pressed buttons, closes the heading menu and invalidates

properties.name: font
properties.comment: The body font. Headings scale it; code is set in the monospace role at its size. Throws std::invalid_argument for an invalid FontSpec.
hand: shared FontCapability<RichTextBox>; prepare validates and marks the font as set from code

not_properties.name: markdown / set_markdown
not_properties.reason: a document load (string_view source, history cleared), not a value; the source is the engine's text

not_properties.name: auto_scroll
not_properties.reason: ScrollableControl's cell; RichTextBox reacts through on_auto_scroll_changed
